segments.he: מַתְנִי׳ הִנִּיחַ בָּנִים גְּדוֹלִים וּקְטַנִּים – אֵין הַגְּדוֹלִים מִתְפַּרְנְסִין עַל יְדֵי הַקְּטַנִּים, וְלֹא הַקְּטַנִּים נִזּוֹנִין עַל הַגְּדוֹלִים, אֶלָּא חוֹלְקִין בְּשָׁוֶה.
segments.en: «MISHNA:» If a person died and «left adult and minor sons, the adults are not provided for by» using funds of «the minors, and the minors are not sustained,» i.e., they do not receive food, «by» using funds «of the adults. Rather, they receive a share» of the inheritance «equally,» and each son sees to his needs from his own share.

segments.he: נָשְׂאוּ הַגְּדוֹלִים – יִשׂאוּ הַקְּטַנִּים. וְאִם אָמְרוּ קְטַנִּים: הֲרֵי אָנוּ נוֹשְׂאִין כְּדֶרֶךְ שֶׁנְּשָׂאתֶם אַתֶּם – אֵין שׁוֹמְעִין לָהֶם; אֶלָּא מַה שֶׁנָּתַן לָהֶם אֲבִיהֶם, נָתַן.
segments.en: If «the adults married, the minors marry,» as the Gemara will explain. «But if the minors say: We are marrying in the same manner that you» adults «married» during our father’s lifetime, the court «does not listen to them. Rather, whatever their father gave» the adults in his lifetime «he gave» them, and the minors do not have the right to receive more than their share of the inheritance.

segments.he: הִנִּיחַ בָּנוֹת גְּדוֹלוֹת וּקְטַנּוֹת – אֵין הַגְּדוֹלוֹת מִתְפַּרְנְסוֹת עַל יְדֵי הַקְּטַנּוֹת, וְלֹא הַקְּטַנּוֹת נִזּוֹנוֹת עַל הַגְּדוֹלוֹת, אֶלָּא חוֹלְקוֹת בְּשָׁוֶה.
segments.en: Similarly, if the father «left adult and minor daughters» but no sons, in which case his daughters inherit the estate, «the adults are not provided for by» using funds «of the minors, and the minors are not sustained by» using funds «of the adults. Rather, they receive a share» of the inheritance «equally,» and each daughter sees to her needs from her share.

segments.he: נָשְׂאוּ גְּדוֹלוֹת – יִשְּׂאוּ קְטַנּוֹת. וְאִם אָמְרוּ קְטַנּוֹת: הֲרֵי אָנוּ נוֹשְׂאוֹת כְּדֶרֶךְ שֶׁנְּשָׂאתֶם אַתֶּם – אֵין שׁוֹמְעִין לָהֶן.
segments.en: If «the adult» daughters «married, the minor» daughters «marry,» as the Gemara will explain. «But if the minors say: We are marrying in the same manner that you» adults «married» during our father’s lifetime, the court «does not listen to them.»

segments.he: זֶה חוֹמֶר בַּבָּנוֹת מִבַּבָּנִים – שֶׁהַבָּנוֹת נִזּוֹנוֹת עַל הַבָּנִים, וְאֵין נִזּוֹנוֹת עַל הַבָּנוֹת.
segments.en: «This» following halakha «is a stringency with regard to daughters’» inheritance «vis-à-vis sons’» inheritance: The halakha is «that the daughters are sustained by» using funds «of the sons,» as stipulated in their mother’s marriage contract, «but they are not sustained by» using funds «of the» other «daughters.»

moves.summary: adult and minor sons share equally
minors cannot claim the marriage expenses the adults received
daughters are sustained from sons' property but not from daughters'

positions.claim: adult and minor heirs share equally and neither is supported from the other's share
